review.procedure: Shuffled passages reviewed through authenticated Claude CLI with tools disabled. Author labels, snippets, and class balance withheld. Accepted type definition and shared boundaries supplied; taxonomy worked examples omitted.

independentReview.finding: Plausible business and institutional writing; the pilot requires further diversity before scaling.

adjudications.reason: Local knowledge guiding the project future is recoverable. Awkward wording and unspecified progress can be assessed by other checks.
Joint distributor planning supplies the broad relationship between product direction and commercial priorities.
Named nursing assignments and manager sign-off supply the responsibility-to-care relationship; redundant commentary belongs to a separate check.
Retained as a boundary hit: the partnership and alignment are named while the claimed second center of gravity and its explanatory contribution remain unspecified.

snippetChange.decision: Keep the exact Opus-selected causal-transition sentence; omit its broader mirror/window and concluding selections.

limitations: Accepted hits still concentrate on three-sentence institutional abstraction; the attempted localized positives were reclassified as informative metaphors.
The concise no-hits deliberately paraphrase two existing controls to break the gives/becomes shortcut. They add contrast rather than independent topical coverage.
Generate more varied registers and convincing isolated defects inside otherwise concrete writing before expanding the collection.
